notes: Box score from the Pistons' 104–86 road win over the Orlando Magic in an NBA Cup group game on Nov 24, 2026, from the Covers box score, checked against the NerdSports recap (player lines for Joe, Jenkins, Huerter, Holland, Collins, Thompson, Bane, Wagner, da Silva and Carter; team field goals 39 of 79 to 34 of 83, threes 15 of 36 to 12 of 36, rebounds 42–41, turnovers 16–20, Detroit's 12 steals and 27 assists) with game details from the Associated Press (via CBS News Detroit), the Detroit Free Press (via Yahoo Sports), SB Nation's Detroit Bad Boys (via Yahoo Sports) and the Daily Tribune. All 104 Detroit points and all 86 Orlando points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (16–32–25–31 to 22–14–25–25) add up to both totals: Orlando led 22–16 after one, Detroit 48–36 at the half (Daily Tribune; NerdSports; Free Press). Team totals (fast-break points 19–9, threes 15–12, steals 12–8, assists 27–22, offensive rebounds 8–10) are from the Covers box score; the fast-break edge is also in the AP and NerdSports. Detroit's biggest lead, 18, is from the box score and the AP ("an 18-point lead in the third quarter"); Orlando's, 7, is from the box score and the Free Press (Magic up 27–20 early in the second). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Tuesday's games.

Detroit scored the first eight points of the second quarter and went on an 18–0 run to win the period 32–14 (AP); the Free Press has the Pistons closing the half on a 28–9 run from 27–20 down. Cade Cunningham (right knee soreness) was ruled out shortly before tip (AP; Free Press). Isaiah Joe, in his first start for Detroit (AP), scored 21 with 14 in the second half and three straight threes in the fourth (AP). Ausar Thompson had 6 points, 10 rebounds, 7 assists and 4 blocks (box score; AP). Detroit snapped a two-game losing streak (site results: losses to Toronto and Atlanta), is 2–1 in NBA Cup group play and handed Orlando its first Cup loss (AP). Next: the Pistons host Milwaukee on Friday, Nov 27 at 7:30 PM ET (AP; Ball Exclusives via Yardbarker); the Magic visit Washington on Saturday (AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Kevin Huerter's layup with 7:41 left in the third quarter: the Free Press says Detroit was "extending their lead to 15, 57-42, with a layup from Huerter at the 7:41 mark of the third quarter," so the board's Pistons +13 to +15 is 55–42 to 57–42. The move before the layup is not described in the sources read, so the template's plain drive to the rim is drawn. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Detroit Pistons or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Huerter's listed 6-foot-6 and 190 pounds (RealGM), with arms at the default length because no wingspan is reported there, in the Pistons' road kit with No. 27 (RealGM) and the default darker skin tone, since he has no approved look yet. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
